Class Symbiont

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Individual
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Symbiont
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AgentView
public class Symbiont extends Individual
Represents a symbiotic organism living with the colony. Could be mutualistic (aphids) or parasitic (beetles).
